summary: LeonaBio, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce enrollment of the 500th subject in its Phase 3 ELAINE-3 trial and to trigger exercisability of 23,031,494 Series A Common Warrants issued in a December 2025 private placement. Warrants carry a $6.35 cash exercise price or cashless net exercise if a resale registration statement is unavailable, exercisable from the ELAINE-3 Enrollment Date until up to November 30, 2026. Full exercise would yield approximately $146.2 million. No acquisition, divestiture, or board action; the filing is a routine operational/contractual event. Watch warrant exercise and potential capital influx.
